argument: The absence must be carried by the contour and the displaced inner opening, not by a colored scar or a label explaining the field.

A caption-free pair should identify the same off-axis aperture and downstream mass shift before and after lifting the latest absence; if the void reads as a generic decorative eye, the portrait has failed.
Pointer and Enter/Space must register the same bounded absence, while lifting it must restore the exact prior contour, axis, and aperture for comparison.
Negative space can become a fashionable metaphor. Delete v003 if the shape starts reading as a face, or if the readout carries more consequence than the changed silhouette.
